title: Commander Gateway accepted a command
description: Zero3 took ownership of this execution. The file EXISTING is not what makes it true: it must parse, match this schema, and name the expected execution before the bridge treats the command as decided.

correlation.description: Whether the gateway response could be correlated to a task. 'unknown' means Zero3 accepted ownership but the bridge could not extract a task_id: the command must NOT be resubmitted, because Zero3 may already be executing it. Reconciliation resolves it.

task_id.description: Correlation handle returned by the gateway.

correlation_problem.description: Why correlation failed, when correlation is 'unknown'.
